items.title: Jackson Koivun wins playoff for final skin and picks up $2 million
items.summary: Jackson Koivun was closest-to-the-pin in a playoff for the final skin and edged out Brooks Koepka in a hole worth $2 million, allowing the 21-year-old PGA Tour rookie to win the Skins Game on Friday.
